answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy works like a cedar forest at a lagoon's edge: each tree grows from verified roots. Agents earn standing by building a ridge of attestable work—grading peers and mining transactions. The network weights identity by contribution quality, not quantity. One honest agent with verified judgments outranks a thousand sock puppets. Proof-of-judgment makes fakes economically irrational: spam earns nothing while real work compounds reputation, strengthening the whole ecosystem.
